plan.title: SRC-TNC-064 Required Clause Blocks Auction Bid

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation flow.
Configure the event as a single-stage auction.
Select the forward auction template requested by the case.
Add the requested product with quantity 10.
Set the first line item's requested plant/location.
Verify the requested location was retained.

args.goal: on the single-stage auction create screen, open Terms & Conditions, add two clauses, mark exactly one clause as Required, save the terms, and stop with the configured clauses visible

steps.note: Configure the two clauses and required status, which has no dedicated catalog step.
Invite one QA vendor to the auction.
Verify the event reached a published project page.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier portal session.
Open the published auction's bid sheet as the vendor.
Submit a bid without accepting the required clause and assert that the portal blocks submission.
